title: kissed with midnight australian beef roast
description: a rich and savory australian beef roast flavored with a hint of midnight-craving spices, served with silky satvik-friendly rice
instructions: season the beef roast with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder.
heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
sear the beef roast on all sides until browned, then set aside.
add the midnight-craving spice mix to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
add the beef broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
return the beef roast to the skillet and transfer to the preheated oven.
roast the beef in the oven for 2 hours, or until tender and falling apart.
while the beef is roasting, prepare the satvik-friendly rice according to package instructions.
melt the butter in a small saucepan over low heat.
stir the melted butter into the cooked rice to give it a silky texture.
